links.outcome: Dental professionals' implant identification performance with versus without AI assistance, compared with standalone AI
links.effect: AI assistance significantly improved all metrics across all implant groups (p<0.05) except recall of NucleOSS T4, but assisted performance stayed below standalone AI, indicating automation bias.
links.quote: AI assistance improved participants’ diagnostic performance across all implant categories but did not exceed the standalone AI model, underscoring the impact of human–AI interaction and automation bias.

screen.reason: The study directly evaluates the impact of AI assistance on dental professionals' diagnostic performance in a reader study comparing clinician performance with vs without AI assistance.
